title: Three Evenings and One Short Fuse
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：firework　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 firework 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandmother ① lit a firework that no neighbour in the town would have watched, and she said the lighting was the whole of the evening. The ② firework, meaning the rocket itself and not the light, ran three evenings and stayed unwatched in the book; a firework, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unwatched.

Every ③ firework in that town had the same short fuse beside it, and the ④ firework at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A firework, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to watch; my grandmother said the watching is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the firework was the whole of the matter, meaning the display and not the rocket. The ⑥ firework, meaning the display and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody watches; firework, he said, is either something you light or the only word that means both a rocket and a display. He said the display is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ firework had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short fuse. The ⑧ firework of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in October, was one town and three evenings of watching; firework, she said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to watch. She said the watching was never mentioned.

The ⑨ firework I remember is the one written in the plan, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ firework, my mother said in 1972, is the only one that improves by being watched; every firework, she said, is a display that has agreed to look like a rocket. She said the display was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 烟花；爆竹（指镇上每一枚旁边的那一枚）
B. n. 烟花（指那一枚本身，与火光相对）
C. 固定搭配：light a firework 点燃一枚烟花
D. n. 烟花（指留给孩子们的那一枚）
E. n. 烟花（抽象总称，指一个镇上的燃放之事）
F. n. 烟花（指计划里写到、被人看过的那一枚）
G. n. 烟火表演；放烟花的场面（指一件事里人人都等却无人看过的那样东西）
H. n. 烟火表演（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人看过的那样东西）

items.q: lit a firework that no neighbour in the town would have watched
The firework, meaning the rocket itself and not the light
the firework at the far end
the firework was the whole of the matter
the firework had become a line in a plan
The firework of the whole thing
A firework, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: light a firework 意为“点燃一枚烟花”，1961 年祖母点燃了一枚镇上没有一位邻居肯观看的烟花。
firework 意为“烟花”，指那一枚本身而不是火光，它经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有人观看。
firework 意为“烟花”，指镇上每一枚旁边的那一枚，每一枚旁边都有同一根短短的引线。
firework 意为“烟花”，指留给孩子们的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
firework 意为“烟火表演、放烟花的场面”，指一件事里人人都等却无人看过的那样东西，叔叔说这场表演就是那件事的全部。
firework 意为“烟火表演”，指人人都等却无人看过的那样东西而不是那一枚烟花，是事情里人人都等、却无人看过的东西。
firework 意为“烟花”，指计划里写到、被人看过的那一枚，到 1968 年这一枚成了计划里的一行。
firework 意为“烟花”，祖母十月写道，整件事的燃放之事是一个镇子和三个傍晚的观看。
firework 意为“烟花”，我记得的是计划里写下的那一枚，1970 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一枚。
firework 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，一枚烟花是唯一会因为被好好观看而变得更好的东西。
